tool_args.rationale: The threshold model failed fresh confirmation, while the observed inputs co-vary and leave plausible temporal/memory mechanisms unresolved. A trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe to distinguish those mechanisms before fitting another model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter threshold-avalanche siphon now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 0.746 is far above 0.045, so this model is not adequate.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not address the model mismatch.
The failure refutes the fitted stationary model but does not establish non-stationarity or refute all plausible stationary mechanisms.
